author: Bellular News
description:
Sam Altman thinks the RAM in your PC would be better used in a datacentre. Meanwhile, Amazon and Microsoft have hardware they can't even plug in. We look at why they keep buying, how Nvidia benefits, and why gamers are being priced out while the world's biggest companies fight over the supply.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
